reuse.why: A single eligibility predicate (isEligibleForMonthAction, reusing extractTagsFromText for #fixed) serves every month-wide action including copyPreviousMonth, but setLastMonthSpending re-queries transaction sums instead of reading the existing sum-amount sheet cells via getSheetValue, and setMonthAverage re-implements setNMonthAvg's average-and-sign logic instead of calling it.

duplication.why: The spending SQL in setLastMonthSpending copies base.ts getSumAmountsByMonth's filters; setMonthAverage duplicates setNMonthAvg; the template rule is checked both in getMonthActionCategories' SQL and in isEligibleForMonthAction.

placement.why: Selection and actions stay in budget/actions.ts and the method is registered in budget/app.ts, but a raw transaction-sum query is placed in the action layer while the tree computes those sums in the sheet layer (base.ts).

scope.why: Folding set3/6/12MonthAvg into a new setMonthAverage that no longer goes through setNMonthAvg is restructuring beyond the requests.

maintainability.why: Exclusion rules are now in one predicate used everywhere, which is good, but a second source of monthly spending and a second averaging path will drift from the sheet and setNMonthAvg.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending queries v_transactions_internal_alive directly instead of the sum-amount sheet cells; setMonthAverage bypasses setNMonthAvg.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending's grouped SUM query reshapes getSumAmountsByMonth (base.ts) per month; setMonthAverage re-expresses setNMonthAvg's getCategoryAverage + sign flip; template exclusion split between SQL and !goal_def.

abstraction_drift.where: isEligibleForMonthAction/getMonthActionCategories gained includeHiddenCategories with an OR-branch skipping the hidden checks; every month-wide action calls it, none re-implements it.
